data.name: Omran
data.gender_notes: Omran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Umran’, meaning ‘a man from the mountains’ or ‘mountain dweller’. In Islamic history, Omran is the name of a nobleman who welcomed Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and his family when they were evicted from the city of Mecca. The name Omran carries the meaning “Mountain man” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Omran usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Omran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Omran total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عمران
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يدل على القوة و البناء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عمران مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عمر' الذي يعني البناء أو القوة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران. يحمل الاسم دلالات القوة و البناء و التجديد. في التاريخ الإسلامي، كان عمران شخصية محترمة و له مكانة عالية

in_urdu.name: عمران
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمران نام عربی جڑ 'عمر' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوطی یا تعمیر۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں آل عمران سورة میں ذکر ہوا ہے۔ یہ نام طاقت، مضبوطی، اور نئی شروعات کی دلالت کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام تاریخی اور روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: उमरन
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमरन नाम अरबी जड़ 'उमर' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है मजबूती या निर्माण। यह नाम कुरआन में آل عمران सورة में उल्लेखित है। यह नाम शक्ति, मजबूती, और नए शुरुआत की प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: عمران
in_pashto.long_meaning: عمران نوم د عربی جڑ 'عمر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د قوت یا ودې معنی ورکوي. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې د آل عمران سورة کې ذکر شوی دی. دا نوم د قوت، ودې، او نوي پیل د نښې نښانې کوي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د پام وړ تاريخي او روحاني ارزښت لري

in_english.name: Omran
in_english.meaning: Means strength, power, and building in Arabic

The name signifies power, strength, and renewal. Historically, it holds a respected position in Islamic tradition, symbolizing resilience and spiritual growth. Across Muslim cultures, Omran remains a meaningful and culturally significant name

data.cultural_impact: The name Omran holds cultural significance in rural communities, particularly in regions with mountainous terrain. It is a testament to the strength and resilience of individuals living in harsh environments. In many cultures, the mountain folk are revered for their self-sufficiency and adaptability, and the name represents the thankfulness and respect given to them for their contributions to society.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic traditions, the name Omran carries deep spiritual significance as it references a pivotal moment in Prophet Ibrahim’s life. The hospitality of the mountain dweller Omran reflects the Quranic value of treating guests with kindness and generosity. It is a reminder that even in the face of adversity and displacement, it is essential to show compassion and solidarity towards others. The story of Omran and Prophet Ibrahim’s encounter reinforces the message of unity, strength, and compassion in the face of challenges.

historical_references.context: Omran ibn Al-Khattab was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and was chosen as the second caliph after his death. He ruled from 614 to 624 AD and is considered a just and fair ruler.
